notes.title: Secret Words + New Games + Steam Deck Verification!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone!

Some announcements we'd like to make:

The Horrorscope is now officially Steam Deck Verified!
The Test Trilogy is also officially Steam Deck Verified including The Test: Final Revelation!

We are currently working on the development of multiple other titles as well as Chasing Demons.

We'd also like to mention for those who have been wondering if it's too late to provide Secret Words on our titles. The answer to that question is:

"It is NEVER too late to participate with your secret words or votes on our games!"

We will always find a use for the words you provide and every word is useful for Chasing Demons, as well as a few other projects we're currently working on that we're excited to announce in the near future!

We are still in need of more votes for The Advisor - Episode 1 in order for us to finish development on The Advisor - Episode 2, so if you haven't done so yet, please make sure you provide your votes on whether Magnus should leave, or stay, and we will credit you for your participation in the credits of Episode 2!

Your Secret Words will come in handy for each and every one of our titles, (Including The Test Trilogy) and will play a pretty pivotal role in upcoming projects.

For those of you who haven't played all of our games, you can find them heavily discounted and currently on sale in our Deluxe Bundle below:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13174/Randumb_Studios_Deluxe_Bundle/

Thank you so much for your participation and support, and we look forward to hearing more from you in the future!

- Randumb Studios[/b]

notes.title: Deluxe Bundle Sale!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Thank you so much for supporting us across our titles!
We're currently offering a deal on our Deluxe Bundle that features ALL of our currently released titles!

You can find the best possible deal in the bundle below:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13174/Randumb_Studios_Deluxe_Bundle/

We hope you enjoy your experience with our games, and we hope The Advisor and The Testing Chamber gives you the satisfaction you deserve!

notes.title: Want to be a part of Chasing Demons? (Read!)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I just wanted to clear up some curiosity and provide an update on the future of our games!

Despite our reveal in The Test 3: Final Revelation upon it's release, it is NOT too late to leave a comment for us on each of our titles to participate in the upcoming release of our main project, Chasing Demons!

As revealed in The Test 3, we will be adding the names of players who leave a comment with their secret words into the credits of Chasing Demons, and we will also be selecting some of your names to be present in the game itself!

Some of your names will be selected to be an item of great lore, NPCs that are a part of the world, and even bosses! - We're looking at you Mr. Massacre. ;) - (Just to name 1 particular individual who's been extra supportive of our games, trust me, there's quite a few of you we've taken notice to and we never miss reading your comments and reviews. They really mean the world to us and we really appreciate you taking the time to support us!)

We're also releasing a fun new title, Survivor Dieland on March 1st at 10:00 AM PST (6:00 PM GMT). You can add it to your Wishlist to receive notifications through this link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1524250/Survivor_Dieland/

Every game we release is somewhat of a prequel to Chasing Demons, as we will be fitting the characters that administer the tests into the game world.

For those that don't know, Chasing Demons is being developed as a Choices Matters RPG where every interaction in the world will have some bearing on your gameplay!

If you'd like to add Chasing Demons to your Wishlist, you can do so here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1441750/Chasing_Demons/

If you'd like to follow our Curator Page for notifications on game releases, you can do so here:
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38637514

And if you'd like to try our other games, we'd absolutely love to hear your feedback and secret words as we use them to develop our other titles!
You can find them all discounted in this bundle below:
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/13174/Randumb_Studios_Deluxe_Bundle/

Again, it's never too late to participate and we appreciate all of your continued support!
Thank you so much and we hope you have an amazing year!

- Randumb Studios
